title: Prologue — The eagle answered
description: Opens the deck with the eagle story. Full-bleed eagle image, story in the deck's serif, closing line set apart. Same prologue appears in the Deer Lake Store deck and at the top of Headwaters Books and the Practitioner's Guide V2 home pages — one moment, four pieces.

title: Cover
description: V3 cover — Headwaters as a product company for Northern Indigenous food systems. Six numbers locked, tagline previewed.

title: Slab vs grassland
description: Foundation thesis — V2 was a slab (one client, one contract, brittle). V3 is a grassland (three product layers, many bands, rooted).

title: The six people
description: V3 lean roster — six roles, locked monthly numbers. Where V2 had eight, V3 has six; same work, no double-payment.

title: Three revenue layers
description: Software (Deer Lake Layer-1 $420k/yr today; full-stack agency upgrade ask at $90k/mo absorbs it), Tech Stack at Markup (hybrid pricing, tiered hardware, ~$5k Y1), Training ($5,500/cohort, 3/yr in Deer Lake bundle).

title: Year One — surfaced honestly
description: Honest Year-1 cash picture: revenue $446,598 vs cost $573,800 = ($127,202) gap, plus $112k Capital Recovery from V2 still standing (tax-free debt repayment to lender + family — NOT income, NOT compensation, NOT a deductible expense). Paths to close it listed.

title: Closing the Y1 gap — second anchor
description: Direct answer to the $127k Year-1 gap surfaced by the previous slide. Three concrete second-anchor shapes (single install, install + retainer, Tier-2 subscription stack) with the math worked out, plus a M3/M6/M9 timing strip showing the latest the second anchor can land and still close the gap. Numbers derive from the same cross-reserve install pricing and retainer the deck already publishes.

title: Path to scale — Y1 / Y2 / Y3
description: CFO-readable Y1 → Y2 → Y3 composition. Y1 = $1.08M Deer Lake only. Y2 = $1.08M Deer Lake + $357k cross-reserve (2 installs + 2 retainers) = $1.44M. Y3 = $1.08M Deer Lake + $417k cross-reserve (2 installs + 4 active retainers) = $1.50M. Every figure live-bound to the registry via useAppState + getLiveCostValue/resolveCost.

title: Sell-timing — when Pilot #2 outbound starts
description: Lands the cross-deck timing call between Path-to-scale and Closing. Outbound to a 3–5 named-prospect bench fires on Day-90, when Deer Lake produces its first audited value-delivered number and a live reference call — not before, not after Pilot #2 finishes writing. Carries the same Day-1 → Day-90 → Day-180 milestone vocabulary used on the Deer Lake Store deck's FirstReserveThenTheNext slide and the Practitioner's Guide V2 Replication page operating-rhythm callout. Reframes Pilot #2 as a paid engagement that becomes the case study, not a written deliverable that precedes the sale. Names the three failure modes the call protects against (sell pre-pilot, wait for pilot #2 to finish writing, tinker without a buyer in the loop). Flags the named-prospect list, Day-90 audit template, and outreach kit as queued — this slide is the timing call, not the assets.

title: Closing
description: Mission anchor + tagline closing. 'We always knew how to fix it. Now we can.' on dark forest-green field.
